verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes has no dedicated feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. The building blocks exist, though: point-in-time directory snapshots that can be restored from R2 give a form of rollback, and the Git guide covers cloning, branch management, and automated Git operations for versioning code run in the sandbox. Users would have to assemble the workflow themselves. Missing for 10: first-class automation version history, review/diff or approval flow, one-step rollback of automation definitions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
